title: Going to School Together and Making a Debut
overview: Now officially dating, Amane and Mahiru surprise their classmates when they go public with their relationship.

title: The Start of Summer Vacation
overview: Amane and Mahiru discuss their feelings and then spend a day at the pool, where Mahiru debuts a new swimsuit.

title: Homecoming, and Revealing the Relationship
overview: While visiting Amane's parents, Mahiru learns about Amane's youth and Amane runs into a figure from his past.

title: A Stay-at-Home Date With the Angel
overview: The family goes shopping and then Amane and Mahiru have a date at home when rain spoils their plans to go out.

title: A Summer Festival With the Angel
overview: After returning from their visit to Amane's hometown, Amane takes Mahiru out to see her first summer festival.

title: A Once-Desired, Now Undesired Meeting, and a Resolution
overview: Amane and Mahiru discuss their options when a man from Mahiru's past unexpectedly shows up at their building.

title: The Angel's Pleas
overview: Mahiru and Amane talk about next steps as they get ready for the culture festival and their class's maid café.

title: Culture Festival, Day One
overview: Mahiru and Amane get a lot of attention dressed up for their maid and butler cafe during the school festival.

title: The Angel's Request
overview: Amane's parents visit the school festival and Itsuki explains why his father is unwilling to accept Chitose.

title: An Important Promise With the Angel
overview: Amane worries about taking proper responsibility before he and Mahiru embark on a more intimate relationship.

title: First Part-Time Job
overview: Amane goes behind Itsuki's back and starts a part-time job in order to save up for a special gift for Mahiru.

title: The Angel's Big Day Arrives
overview: Mahiru prepares a special meal for Amane on a special day, and the two clarify their feelings for each other.
